papers.title: GATE EC 2026 Trend-Based Mock Paper 1
papers.description: Balanced mix of core EC topics with emphasis on Networks, Signals & Systems, and Electronic Devices. High-frequency PYQs from 2021–2025.
papers.predictionRationale: This paper emphasizes Network, Signals & Systems combined with Electronic Devices (~23 marks). Analog and Digital Circuits provide the hardware foundation. Control Systems stability questions are placed strategically. Communication Systems and EMFT form the advanced core. NAT questions test numerical precision in Signals and Networks.

questions.questionText: Consider a continuous-time finite-energy signal () whose Fourier transform vanishes outside the frequency interval [- , ], where is in rad/sec. The signal () is uniformly sampled to obtain () = () (). Here, () = ( - - ), =- with () being the Dirac impulse, > 0, and > 0. The sampled signal () sin () is passed through an ideal lowpass filter () = with cutoff frequency and passband gain . The output of the filter is given by ________________.
questions.explanation: Multiplying the sampled signal by sin(πt/T) shifts the replicated spectra by ±π/T. An ideal low‑pass filter with cutoff ω_c = π/T will pass the original baseband component only if the cutoff exceeds the signal bandwidth Ω (i.e., ω_c > Ω, which is equivalent to the condition given in option D). In that case the output of the filter is exactly the original signal x(t).

questions.subject: Network, Signals & Systems
questions.questionText: Which of the following statements is/are TRUE with respect to ideal MOSFET- based DC-coupled single-stage amplifiers having finite load resistors?
options: The common-gate amplifier has an infinite input resistance
The common-source amplifier has an infinite input resistance
The input and output voltages of the common-source amplifier are in phase
The input and output voltages of the common-drain amplifier are in phase
questions.explanation: In an ideal MOSFET, the gate draws no DC current, giving the common‑source stage an infinite input resistance (B). The common‑drain (source‑follower) stage provides a non‑inverting voltage gain, so its input and output voltages are in phase (D). The common‑gate stage has low input resistance, not infinite (A false), and the common‑source stage inverts the signal, giving a 180° phase shift (C false).
questions.source: Adapted from GATE 2025 EC Session 1 Q30

questions.questionText: Consider a system where 1(), 2(), and 3() are three internal state signals and () is the input signal. The differential equations governing the system are given by 1() 2 0 0 1() 1 [2()] = [0 -2 0] [2()] + [1] (). 3() 0 0 0 3() 1 Which of the following statements is/are TRUE?
options: The signals 1(), 2(), and 3() are bounded for all bounded inputs
There exists a bounded input such that at least one of the signals 1(),
There exists a bounded input such that the signals 1(), 2(), and 3() are
The signals 1(), 2(), and 3() are unbounded for all bounded inputs
questions.explanation: With the given state equations \dot{x}_1 = -2x_2 + u, \dot{x}_2 = 0, \dot{x}_3 = u, a bounded input such as a step (u(t)=1) is bounded but its integral grows without bound, causing x_1(t) and x_3(t) to become unbounded. questions.subject: General Aptitude
questions.questionText: Five years ago, the ratio of Aman's age to his father's age was 1:4, and five years from now, the ratio will be 2:5. What was his father's age when Aman was born?
questions.explanation: Let A and F be Aman’s and his father’s present ages. Five years ago (A-5)/(F-5)=1/4 ⇒ F=4A-15. Five years later (A+5)/(F+5)=2/5 ⇒ F=(5A+15)/2. Equating gives 4A-15=(5A+15)/2 ⇒ A=15, F=45. Father’s age when Aman was born = F‑A = 45‑15 = 30 years.
questions.source: Adapted from GATE 2024 EC Session 7 Q3

questions.questionText: Let X (t) = Acos(2 f0t + ) be a random process, where amplitude A and phase are independent of each other, and are uniformly distributed in the intervals [-2, 2] and [0, 2 ] , respectively. X (t) is fed to an 8-bit uniform mid-rise type quantizer. Given that the autocorrelation of X (t) is RX ( ) = 2 cos(2 f0 ) , the signal to 3 quantization noise ratio (in dB, rounded off to two decimal places) at the output of the quantizer is __________.
questions.explanation: The signal range is [-2,2] so step size Δ = 4/256 = 0.015625. Quantization noise variance = Δ²/12. Signal variance from given autocorrelation is σ_X² = R_X(0) = 2. Hence SNR = σ_X² / (Δ²/12) = 24/Δ² = 24·4096 = 98304. In dB: 10·log10(98304) ≈ 49.92 dB.

questions.questionText: and are Bernoulli random variables taking values in {0,1}. The joint probability mass function of the random variables is given by: ( = 0, = 0) = 0.06 ( = 0, = 1) = 0.14 ( = 1, = 0) = 0.24 ( = 1, = 1) = 0.56 The mutual information (; ) is _________ (rounded off to two decimal places). Electronics and Communication Engineering (EC)
questions.explanation: The marginals are pX(0)=0.20, pX(1)=0.80 and pY(0)=0.30, pY(1)=0.70. Each joint probability equals the product of the corresponding marginals (e.g., 0.06 = 0.20×0.30, 0.14 = 0.20×0.70, etc.), indicating X and Y are independent. Hence the mutual information I(X;Y)=∑p(x,y)log2[p(x,y)/(pX(x)pY(y))]=0, which rounded to two decimal places is 0.00.
